cases.name: the defaults accept an ordinary payload
nesting past max_depth is depth_exceeded
cases.note: Order > lines[] > Line > unit > Money is four levels, so a limit of two refuses it and a limit of four does not.

cases.name: a limit that the payload fits is not an error
a string past max_string_bytes is size_exceeded
an object past max_object_keys is size_exceeded
cases.note: The root itself carries six keys.

cases.name: an array past max_items is refused
cases.note: max_items is a limit on hostile input, distinct from @max_items on a field, which is a rule of the schema and reports too_many_items.

cases.name: max_string_bytes counts bytes, not characters
cases.note: Four characters, but eight bytes in UTF-8, so a limit of four refuses it. The rule @max_len counts scalar values instead; the two measure different things on purpose.
